pure_miss_lookahead256.hypothesis: Miss callbacks also expose one true next Probe; jointly allocate mandatory target and next, avoiding a subsequent miss even when periodic callbacks are rare. Forego its extra lookahead, so may regress.
pure_miss_lookahead256.observations: Only current SystemState and next_op; no penalty, future stream, shadow requests or input header
pure_miss_lookahead256.scope: explicit transfer-risk tradeoff, not a guarantee; both object sizes fit together; mandatory target last LOAD
